title: Rename, delete or remove a student

steps.say: The pencil beside the **Manage class** heading renames the class. Only the name changes — the roster, the join link and the class's place on the course all carry on.
The bin beside the **Manage class** heading deletes the class. The app tells you what goes with it first, and asks you to type the class name when there is real practice behind it.
**Remove** at the end of a student's row in the roster takes them off this class only. Their account and everything they've learned stays with them, and they can join another class straight away.
steps.terminal: Rename, delete, remove a student — all from the class's own tools page. This tour changed nothing; only your own taps do.
